question: What are TJR's exact Asian and London session open/close times, and does 'session high/low' include pre-market or regular hours only?
whyItMatters: The corpus states only the New York figures -- pre-market 08:30 (CLAIM|TJR|20260727|003) and the NYSE regular open 09:30 Eastern (CLAIM|TJR|20260727|057). Session highs and lows are a draw-on-liquidity class (CLAIM|TJR|20260727|009) and session opens are the first thing marked each day (CLAIM|TJR|20260727|010), so undefined session boundaries leave those levels uncomputable for every session but New York. Note this is NOT answerable by reusing MOGO's shipped TJR_SLR engine: that engine resolves ASIAN/LONDON/NEW_YORK in Europe/London on FX pairs, whereas TJR trades US indices (CLAIM|TJR|20260727|001) on New York time (CLAIM|TJR|20260727|055). The engine's boundaries are an implementation choice, not evidence about TJR.
